data.cultural_impact: The name Tawwad signifies the act of giving and receiving in the Islamic community. It carries the practical application of the Islamic value of kindness and generosity. This name encapsulates the spirit of giving, which is essential in maintaining harmonious relationships with family, friends and the wider community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Tawwad can be traced back to the Islamic concept of sadaqah (voluntary giving to charity). In the Islamic tradition, giving with a kind and generous heart is seen as an act of purifying one's soul, bringing one closer to Allah (God). Moreover, receiving blessings and gifts from others is also a reminder of Allah's endless generosity and mercy. As such, the name Tawwad embodies the essential Islamic virtues of giving and receiving with a spirit of gratitude and compassion.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Athir, Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh. Vol. 4, p. 333. The caliphate of Harun al-Rashid (786-809 AD) The name Tawwad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Tawwad ibn Mansur: A vizier and chief financial administrator during the caliphate of Harun al-Rashid. He was known for his honesty, intelligence, and efficiency. Tawwad was also a patron of learning, and is said to have collected a vast library.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abi Dawud, Sunan. Vol. 1, p. 349. The period of the Rightly Guided Caliphs and the Umayyads (632-750 AD)
historical_references.context: Tawwad ibn Qais: A companion of the Prophet Muhammad and a scribe during the caliphate of Umar ibn Al-Khattab. He is mentioned in hadiths as being present when the Prophet Muhammad taught the Muslims how to write and record transactions.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Tawwad, meaning 'to remember and to be devoted', is gaining popularity in modern contexts as a hashtag and account name on social media platforms such as Instagram, Pinterest, and YouTube. On Instagram, users may post images of Islamic art or quotes from the Quran as a reminder of their faith. On Pinterest, Tawwad may be used as a board name for collecting and organizing religious and spiritual inspiration. On YouTube, Tawwad may refer to a channel dedicated to Islamic teachings, meditation practices, or self-care routines. Overall, the use of Tawwad on social media reflects a growing trend towards personal spiritual expression and exploration within the Islamic community.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Khadija Tawwad in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Tawwad, which means "Gift, Reward". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
